arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Virginia's advocate argued that consent to multiple trials waives double jeopardy claims.
Currier's advocate argued that issue preclusion applies when severance is legally required.
Justices questioned the practical impact of barring a second trial on remaining charges.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This case defines the limits of double jeopardy protection. It determines whether defendants can waive constitutional rights through procedural consent. The outcome shapes how prosecutors structure multi-charge cases. It affects the balance between state efficiency and individual liberty.
